<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Veltrivex Global - Learn & Earn Certificates</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;700;900&family=Nunito:wght@300;400;600;700&family=Great+Vibes&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --gold: #f5b700;
  --gold-light: #ffd84d;
  --blue-deep: #0e1a2b;
  --blue-mid: #1c2b4a;
  --blue-card: #16233b;
  --blue-accent: #007bff;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --gray: #cccccc;
}
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
body { font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif; background:var(--blue-deep); color:var(--white); overflow-x:hidden; scroll-behavior:smooth; }

/* ===== HEADER ===== */
header {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a1220,var(--blue-mid));
  padding:15px 40px;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:200;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(245,183,0,0.2);
}
header img { height:65px; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(245,183,0,0.5)); }
nav { display:flex; gap:5px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:flex-end; }
nav a {
  color:var(--white); padding:7px 14px; text-decoration:none;
  font-weight:600; font-size:13px; border-radius:20px; transition:all 0.3s;
}
nav a:hover { background:var(--gold); color:#000; transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero {
  text-align:center; padding:90px 20px 70px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#1e3a6e 0%,var(--blue-deep) 70%);
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.hero::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; top:-50%; left:-50%;
  width:200%; height:200%;
  background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0deg,rgba(245,183,0,0.03) 60deg,transparent 120deg);
  animation:rotate 20s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes rotate { to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
.hero-logo {
  height:140px; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 35px rgba(245,183,0,0.8));
  animation:pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; position:relative; z-index:1;
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(245,183,0,0.5))}
  50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 45px rgba(245,183,0,1))}
}
.hero h1 {
  font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:44px; color:var(--gold);
  margin:20px 0 8px; position:relative; z-index:1;
  text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(245,183,0,0.4);
}
.hero h2 { font-size:17px; color:var(--gray); font-weight:300; margin-bottom:10px; position:relative; z-index:1; }
.hero-tagline { font-size:13px; color:rgba(245,183,0,0.7); letter-spacing:3px; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:35px; position:relative; z-index:1; }
.hero-btns { display:flex; gap:15px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; position:relative; z-index:1; }

/* ===== BUTTONS ===== */
.btn {
  display:inline-block; padding:13px 32px; border-radius:30px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:14px;
  transition:all 0.3s; cursor:pointer; border:none;
  letter-spacing:0.5px; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;
}
.btn-gold { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#e6a800); color:#000; box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(245,183,0,0.4); }
.btn-gold:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(245,183,0,0.7); }
.btn-blue { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#007bff,#0056b3); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(0,123,255,0.4); }
.btn-blue:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,123,255,0.6); }
.btn-red { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff0000,#cc0000); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(255,0,0,0.3); }
.btn-red:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); }
.btn-sm { padding:9px 20px; font-size:13px; }

/* ===== SECTION COMMON ===== */
.section-title { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:30px; color:var(--gold); text-align:center; margin-bottom:10px; }
.section-sub { text-align:center; color:var(--gray); margin-bottom:35px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.7; }
.divider { width:80px; height:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent); margin:10px auto 30px; }

/* ===== COURSES ===== */
.courses-section { padding:70px 40px; }
.courses-grid {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));
  gap:25px; max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto;
}
.course-card {
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1a2d4e,var(--blue-card));
  border-radius:18px; padding:30px;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.15); transition:all 0.4s;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.course-card::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0;
  width:100%; height:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--blue-accent));
}
.course-card:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); border-color:rgba(245,183,0,0.5); box-shadow:0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
.course-icon { font-size:40px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.course-card h3 { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; color:var(--gold); font-size:18px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.course-card .instructor { color:var(--gray); font-size:13px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.course-card .price { font-size:24px; font-weight:700; color:var(--white); margin-bottom:5px; }
.course-card .rating { color:var(--gold); font-size:14px; margin-bottom:20px; }
.card-btns { display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

/* ===== STATS BAR ===== */
.stats-bar {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-mid),#0d1f38);
  padding:40px; display:flex; justify-content:center;
  gap:60px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.1);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.1);
}
.stat-item { text-align:center; }
.stat-num { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:36px; color:var(--gold); font-weight:700; }
.stat-label { color:var(--gray); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; }

/* ===== QUIZ ===== */
.quiz-section { padding:70px 40px; text-align:center; background:var(--blue-mid); }
.quiz-box {
  max-width:620px; margin:0 auto;
  background:var(--blue-card); border-radius:18px;
  padding:45px; border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.2);
  box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}
.quiz-box > p { color:var(--gray); margin-bottom:25px; line-height:1.7; }
.progress-bar-outer { background:#0e1a2b; border-radius:10px; height:16px; margin:15px 0 8px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.1); }
.progress-bar-inner { background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-accent),var(--gold)); height:100%; border-radius:10px; transition:width 0.6s ease; width:0%; }
#progressText { color:#888; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:20px; }
#quizResult { margin-top:15px; color:#4caf50; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; min-height:24px; }
.badge-earned {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(245,183,0,0.12),rgba(245,183,0,0.04));
  border:2px solid var(--gold); border-radius:14px;
  padding:25px; margin-top:20px;
}
.badge-earned h3 { color:var(--gold); font-size:22px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.badge-earned p { color:var(--gray); margin-bottom:15px; }

/* ===== CERTIFICATES ===== */
.cert-section { padding:70px 40px; }
.cert-box {
  max-width:620px; margin:0 auto;
  background:var(--blue-card); border-radius:18px;
  padding:45px; border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.2);
}
.cert-box > p { color:var(--gray); margin-bottom:25px; line-height:1.7; }
.cert-tabs { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:30px; }
.cert-tab {
  flex:1; padding:13px; border-radius:10px;
  border:2px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.2); background:transparent;
  color:var(--gray); cursor:pointer; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;
  font-weight:700; font-size:13px; transition:all 0.3s;
}
.cert-tab.active { border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold); background:rgba(245,183,0,0.08); }
.cert-panel { display:none; }
.cert-panel.active { display:block; }
.cert-input-group { margin-bottom:18px; text-align:left; }
.cert-input-group label { display:block; color:var(--gold); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.cert-input-group input,
.cert-input-group select {
  width:100%; padding:13px 16px; border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.25); background:#0e1a2b;
  color:var(--white); font-size:14px; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif; transition:border-color 0.3s;
}
.cert-input-group input:focus,
.cert-input-group select:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(245,183,0,0.1); }
.cert-input-group select option { background:#0e1a2b; }
.youtube-note {
  background:rgba(255,50,50,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,100,100,0.3);
  border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:18px;
  color:#ff8888; font-size:13px; line-height:1.6;
}
.btn-full { width:100%; text-align:center; display:block; margin-top:8px; }

/* ===== CERTIFICATE MODAL ===== */
.modal-overlay {
  display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.88); z-index:999;
  align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:20px;
}
.modal-overlay.active { display:flex; }
.modal-content { position:relative; max-width:820px; width:100%; }
.modal-close {
  position:absolute; top:-18px; right:-18px;
  background:var(--gold); color:#000; border:none; border-radius:50%;
  width:38px; height:38px; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:700; z-index:10; transition:transform 0.2s;
}
.modal-close:hover { transform:scale(1.1); }

/* ===== CERTIFICATE DESIGN ===== */
.cert-wrapper {
  background:#fffdf5;
  border:14px solid #c8960c;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:45px 55px;
  text-align:center;
  position:relative;
  font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;
  color:#1a1a1a;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.cert-wrapper::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; right:10px; bottom:10px;
  border:2px solid rgba(200,150,12,0.5); border-radius:5px; pointer-events:none;
}
.cert-corner {
  position:absolute; font-size:28px; color:#c8960c; opacity:0.7;
  line-height:1;
}
.cert-corner.tl { top:18px; left:18px; }
.cert-corner.tr { top:18px; right:18px; }
.cert-corner.bl { bottom:18px; left:18px; }
.cert-corner.br { bottom:18px; right:18px; }
.cert-watermark {
  position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-30deg);
  font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:70px;
  color:rgba(200,150,12,0.06); font-weight:900;
  white-space:nowrap; pointer-events:none; user-select:none;
}
.cert-logo { height:85px; margin-bottom:15px; }
.cert-org { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:34px; color:#c8960c; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:3px; margin-bottom:4px; }
.cert-subtitle-cert { font-size:13px; color:#888; letter-spacing:5px; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:22px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,150,12,0.3); padding-bottom:18px; }
.cert-presents { font-size:16px; color:#555; margin-bottom:6px; font-style:italic; }
.cert-name {
  font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive; font-size:54px; color:#1a1a1a;
  margin:10px 0; display:inline-block;
  border-bottom:2px solid #c8960c; padding:0 30px 8px;
  text-shadow:1px 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.cert-completed { font-size:15px; color:#555; margin:18px 0 6px; }
.cert-course { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; font-size:22px; color:#c8960c; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px; }
.cert-date { font-size:13px; color:#888; margin-bottom:28px; }
.cert-sigs {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-around; align-items:flex-end;
  margin-top:15px; gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cert-sig-block { text-align:center; }
.cert-sig-photo {
  width:65px; height:65px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;
  border:2px solid #c8960c; margin-bottom:8px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(200,150,12,0.3);
}
.cert-sig-line { width:150px; border-top:1.5px solid #1a1a1a; margin:6px auto; }
.cert-sig-name { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#1a1a1a; }
.cert-sig-role { font-size:11px; color:#888; }
.cert-medal { text-align:center; font-size:40px; }
.cert-id { position:absolute; bottom:20px; right:22px; font-size:10px; color:#bbb; font-family:monospace; }
.cert-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center; margin-top:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

/* ===== ABOUT / TEAM ===== */
.about-section { padding:70px 40px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue-deep),#0a1525); }
.team-grid {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));
  gap:35px; max-width:900px; margin:0 auto;
}
.team-card {
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1a2d4e,var(--blue-card));
  border-radius:20px; padding:38px 28px; text-align:center;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.2); transition:all 0.4s;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.team-card::after {
  content:''; position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0;
  width:100%; height:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-accent),var(--gold));
}
.team-card:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); box-shadow:0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-color:rgba(245,183,0,0.5); }
.team-photo {
  width:150px; height:150px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;
  border:4px solid var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(245,183,0,0.4);
  margin-bottom:20px; transition:all 0.4s;
}
.team-card:hover .team-photo { box-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(245,183,0,0.8); transform:scale(1.05); }
.team-card h3 { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; color:var(--gold); font-size:19px; margin-bottom:5px; }
.team-card .role { color:var(--blue-accent); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:15px; letter-spacing:1.5px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.team-card p { color:var(--gray); font-size:13px; line-height:1.8; }
.contact-info { margin-top:18px; }
.contact-info a { color:var(--gold); font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; display:block; margin:4px 0; transition:opacity 0.2s; }
.contact-info a:hover { opacity:0.7; text-decoration:underline; }

/* ===== AUTH ===== */
.auth-section { padding:70px 40px; background:var(--blue-mid); }
.auth-grid {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));
  gap:30px; max-width:720px; margin:0 auto;
}
.auth-card {
  background:var(--blue-card); border-radius:18px;
  padding:38px; border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.15);
}
.auth-card h3 { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:22px; font-size:22px; }
.auth-card input {
  width:100%; padding:13px 16px; margin:8px 0; border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,183,0,0.2); background:#0e1a2b;
  color:var(--white); font-size:14px; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif; transition:border-color 0.3s;
}
.auth-card input:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(245,183,0,0.1); }
.auth-card .btn { width:100%; margin-top:12px; text-align:center; }

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
footer {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060d18,var(--blue-mid));
  text-align:center; padding:50px 20px;
  border-top:2px solid var(--gold);
}
footer img { height:60px; margin-bottom:18px; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(245,183,0,0.5)); }
.footer-tagline { font-family:'Cinzel',serif; color:var(--gold); font-size:16px; margin-bottom:18px; letter-spacing:2px; }
.footer-contacts { margin:12px 0; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:5px 20px; }
.footer-contacts a { color:var(--gold); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; transition:opacity 0.2s; }
.footer-contacts a:hover { opacity:0.7; text-decoration:underline; }
.footer-divider { width:60px; height:1px; background:var(--gold); margin:18px auto; opacity:0.3; }
.copy { font-size:13px; color:#666; }

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media(max-width:768px) {
  header { flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:15px 20px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size:30px; }
  .stats-bar { gap:30px; }
  .courses-section,.about-section,.quiz-section,.cert-section,.auth-section { padding:50px 20px; }
  .cert-wrapper { padding:28px 20px; }
  .cert-org { font-size:22px; }
  .cert-name { font-size:38px; }
  .cert-sigs { flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }
}

@media print {
  body * { visibility:hidden !important; }
  .cert-wrapper, .cert-wrapper * { visibility:visible !important; }
  .cert-wrapper {
    position:fixed !important; top:0 !important; left:0 !important;
    width:100% !important; border:none !important; margin:0 !important;
    box-shadow:none !important;
  }
  .modal-close, .cert-actions { display:none !important; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ===== HEADER ===== -->
<header>
  <img src="data:image/png;base64,
